text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-0417","cls":"operator"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_round3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-2291"},"comment":"swap to fresh FTO plate; initialization carried over from prior session (plate pre-initialized)"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"confirm plate P-2291 loaded and initialized"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":150},"comment":"NiFeCo baseline, within standard thickness envelope"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":400,"duration":60,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"standard anneal per SOP"},{"server":"measure_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12.5,"y":8.0},"comment":"locate deposited spot"},{"server":"measure_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2, nominal rate"},{"server":"analysis_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"model":"gp_overpotential","data_ref":"last_cp"},"comment":"update surrogate with new point"},{"server":"measure_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":2},"comment":"short durability check, 2 h"}]}
